comments.author: Simon
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking: use what you know
comments.text: Hi Amei, Yes, your teacher's job is to help you with this. Anyway, don't worry too much about linking words for speaking. Just focus on the main ideas that you are trying to communicate. If you need time to think, the word "well..." is a good one.
